instruction: Clean studio portrait, medium close-up at eye-level. In an indoor studio with a plain white background, three friends pose closely. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) smiles softly at the camera. In the center, the straight-haired woman in a white sleeveless top (R2) smiles warmly, while on the right, the curly-haired woman in a black top (R3) smiles gently. They huddle in a diagonal line, leaning against one another with hands resting on shoulders. Bright, soft studio lighting illuminates the scene with clean, neutral tones.
